headline: Multiple levers for earnings recovery

highlights: EBITDA grew 62.2% YoY to INR1,048mn, with margins expanding to 9.4% on gross margin improvement and better performance in Africa.
Volumes grew 9% YoY to 14.2mn pieces, while realizations increased by 4% to INR726/pc.
Management expects stronger growth from H2FY27, supported by a healthy order book, currency benefits and withdrawal of customer discounts.
Despite cautious US retailer inventory trends, management expects holiday-season sales to drive higher orders for next year.

Management is targeting the addition of 2-3 factories in FY28, each with a capacity of ~3.5mn pieces.
watch: Realization per piece stood at INR727 (vs INR697 in Q2FY26) Key Conference Call Takeaways: Macro demand outlook • US apparel imports have remained subdued despite resilient retail sales, largely due to retailer inventory destocking and shorter ordering lead times.

Management expects a recovery in imports if the holiday season delivers the projected ~4% growth in retail sales. • Retailers continue to maintain tight inventories amid concerns over inflation and higher oil prices, although management has not witnessed a meaningful deterioration in consumer demand.
